question: How does the public post-trained Qwen3.5-2B execute on the authorized Galaxy S23 Ultra through a reproducible Android CPU route under the canonical fixed-prompt contract?

scope.included: Text-only inference through a third-party Unsloth GGUF conversion on llama.cpp CPU.
excluded: vision inputs or the vision encoder
GPU, NPU, HTP, or proprietary SDK execution
host measurements in the Android registry

upstream_model.name: Qwen/Qwen3.5-2B
upstream_model.architecture: 24-layer dense hybrid: three Gated DeltaNet layers followed by one full-attention layer, repeated six times
upstream_model.source: Pinned official model card and config.json. The official repository is Transformers-format source, not the deployed Android artifact.

deployment_artifact.source_kind: third-party GGUF conversion and quantization derived from Qwen/Qwen3.5-2B
deployment_artifact.format: GGUF v3, one self-contained shard, text model only

quantization.name: Q4_K_M
quantization.weight_scheme: GGML K-quant medium: primarily Q4_K block quantization with the Q4_K_M mixed tensor policy
quantization.block_scheme: Q4_K uses 256-weight super-blocks composed of 32-weight blocks with quantized scales/minima; the M variant retains selected tensors at higher precision according to the quantizer policy.
quantization.conversion_tool_revision_missing_reason: The pinned Unsloth repository and GGUF metadata identify Unsloth, Q4_K_M, and the importance matrix but do not publish the exact converter/quantizer commit. Artifact bytes are still bound by revision, size, and SHA-256; this provenance limitation must remain visible.

tokenizer_and_template.template_difference: The deployed template changes only iteration over tool-call argument mappings. The canonical system+user, no-tools branch is unaffected; canonical rendered bytes are independently hash-bound.

thinking.proof:
Every canonical rendered prompt must end with the exact bytes <think>

</think>

. A nonempty thinking prefix is a fatal mismatch.

route_rationale.chosen: Pinned llama.cpp plus the pinned, already viable GGUF minimized time to a valid Android CPU result.

official_litert_lm_support_check.template_testdata_boundary: A Qwen3.5 Jinja file in recent LiteRT-LM testdata proves template parsing only; it does not prove architecture conversion, a deployable artifact, or Android execution.

tradeoffs: The deployment artifact and quantization are third-party, not official Qwen artifacts.
Runtime and quantization differ from Gemma routes, so model-family comparisons are confounded and must not be presented as architecture-only comparisons.
route_rationale.future_work: Add a separate LiteRT-LM Qwen3.5 arm if official architecture support and deployable Qwen3.5 artifacts become available; never overwrite this route's evidence.

runtime.name: llama.cpp
runtime.build: CMake Release, static llama/GGML and c++_static; only Android system libm/libdl/libc remain dynamic. Source/build paths are prefix-mapped, build metadata is explicit, OpenSSL is disabled, and no web UI is built, downloaded, or embedded.
runtime.embedded_web_ui_reason: The benchmark always launches llama-server with --no-webui. Disabling both LLAMA_BUILD_UI and LLAMA_USE_PREBUILT_UI removes a mutable, inference-unused build input.

historical_android_servers.evidence_scope: Existing Android smoke and interrupted campaign only; never relabel those observations as artifact revision 2.
historical_android_servers.replacement_reason: A clean rebuild exposed an unpinned mutable embedded web-UI input. The UI was disabled at runtime and did not affect inference, but artifact revision 2 removes it and is separately hash-bound for the new campaign.

runtime.greedy_proof: temperature=-1 is normalized to zero in the server generation settings. At the pinned revision, src/llama-sampler.cpp:270-282 retains only the highest-logit token whenever temperature <= 0; the request sampler chain contains only temperature and all penalties are neutral.
runtime.state_reset: The loaded llama-server route and slot/session object remain alive. Before every logical request, POST /slots/0?action=erase must succeed and its duration is recorded separately outside total-request timing. Each completion also sets cache_prompt=false; timings.cache_n must equal zero, prompt_n must equal the full independently tokenized prompt count, and prompt_ms must be positive. This proves full in-session conversation/KV isolation without model remap/reload, accelerator recompilation, or retained prompt/KV reuse. Request 2 is the early in-campaign reset check and stops the campaign if any condition fails.

device.phone_lock: artifacts/locks/phone.lock held across identity, staging, execution, evidence, and cleanup

timing_and_evidence.setup_boundary: Host monotonic timestamp immediately before remote llama-server launch through first successful /health ready response; includes artifact mapping, model/context creation, and readiness polling.
timing_and_evidence.request_boundary: Immediately before native template rendering through final streamed stop delivery. The separately timed slot erase completes before this boundary and is not included in total request.
timing_and_evidence.request_to_first_token: Client request start through the first SSE event carrying a generated token ID.
timing_and_evidence.prefill: llama.cpp final-event prompt_ms and prompt_n; route-internal prompt evaluation timing.
timing_and_evidence.post_prefill_to_first_token: Null because llama.cpp does not expose a server-clock first-token timestamp alignable with aggregate prompt_ms.
timing_and_evidence.decode: External first generated-token event through final stop event, with the first token excluded from the numerator; llama.cpp predicted timing is retained separately and includes all generated tokens.
timing_and_evidence.memory: 100 ms target sampling of /proc/<pid>/smaps_rollup Pss and /proc/<pid>/status VmHWM over the server lifecycle; unavailable samples remain null with reasons.

fatal_gates: wrong workload, model, runtime, runner, device, or staged hash
prompt plus 2048 ceiling exceeds 8192, or server reports truncation
slot erase fails or timings.cache_n is nonzero
unauthorized/destructive device operation or phone-lock violation
raw output cannot be bound to the claimed request
nullable_not_fatal: individual thermal sensors unavailable to shell
brief memory peaks missed by 100 ms target sampling
